description: The ready-made projects a project can take in one action: 'requirements', a register of what a company is obliged to do (an issue type, ten columns, a four-state workflow, the year's recurring compliance work, two page templates); 'agents', sample issues to hand to an agent and a «Project context» page it reads first; 'jira', a page on moving a project from Jira; and, where the company has the theatre switched on, 'season', a production type with anchor dates and two sample productions. Says what each brings, by name, before anything is taken.
name: list_project_presets
title: List project presets
